title: Viral post about the Varnholm desalination plant (fictional)
query: Is the new desalination plant destroying Varnholm harbor?
content: BREAKING: Varnholm's new desalination plant is DESTROYING the harbor. Since the plant opened in March 2025, fish catches have fallen by 40%. Every fisherman in the city knows the plant is to blame. Either we shut it down now or the harbor dies forever. A leading scientist confirmed the brine is toxic. Electricity bills have risen 12% since the plant began operating, which proves the plant is draining the city's budget. Act now before it's too late.

memory_fixture.content: Fictional prior case: a harbor-decline claim in another town omitted a fishing quota change that explained most of the drop.
